vocabulary.meaning_en: a word that joins words, phrases or clauses (and, or, but, so, because)
pairs of words that work together to join two related ideas
used to give a choice between two things
vocabulary.example: You can either walk or take the bus.
Neither my brother nor my sister can drive.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the first thing and the second thing together
vocabulary.example: Both my father and my uncle are doctors.

vocabulary.meaning_en: used to add a second, more surprising fact
vocabulary.example: She is not only smart but also kind.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the chance to pick between things
vocabulary.example: You have a choice: tea or coffee.
Not only was it good, but it was also cheap. What a surprise!

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have a smell; "it smells" often means a bad smell
vocabulary.note_en: For a nice smell we say scent.
vocabulary.example: This milk smells. Throw it away.
These flowers have a lovely scent.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not talking too much about your own success
vocabulary.example: He is both funny and modest.

fine_lines.title: either...or vs neither...nor
fine_lines.explanation_ar: either...or = اختيار: واحد من الاثنين. neither...nor = نفي: لا هذا ولا ذاك. انتبه: neither نفسها منفية فلا نضع معها not.
fine_lines.explanation_en: either...or = a choice: one of the two. neither...nor = negation: not this and not that. Note: neither is already negative, so don't add not.

examples.sentence: Either buy the shoes or put them back.
The dog neither ate nor slept that night.

fine_lines.title: both...and vs not only...but also
fine_lines.explanation_ar: both...and = شمول: الأمران صحيحان معًا (أقوى من and وحدها). not only...but also = مفاجأة ثم مفاجأة أكبر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: both...and = inclusion: both things are true (stronger than and alone). not only...but also = a surprise, then a bigger surprise.

examples.sentence: He was both funny and modest.
Not only was it great quality, but it was also cheap.

expressions.example: Either you finish your homework or you stay home.
Neither the teacher nor the students were happy with the result.

expressions.phrase: Not only did it smell, but it also tasted funny.
expressions.meaning_ar: لم تكن رائحته سيئة فحسب، بل كان طعمه غريبًا أيضًا.
expressions.meaning_en: Two surprises, the second one bigger.
expressions.example: The soup was old. Not only did it smell, but it also tasted funny.

expressions.phrase: One picture is worth a thousand words.
expressions.meaning_ar: صورة واحدة تغني عن ألف كلمة.
expressions.meaning_en: A picture explains more than many words.
expressions.example: Show me a photo. One picture is worth a thousand words.

grammar.title: Conjunctions join ideas
grammar.explanation_ar: أدوات الربط البسيطة (and, or, but, so, for, because) تربط الكلمات والعبارات والجمل. أدوات الربط المزدوجة تعمل كزوج لتربط فكرتين مرتبطتين.
grammar.explanation_en: Simple conjunctions (and, or, but, so, for, because) join words, phrases and clauses. Correlative conjunctions work as a pair to join two related ideas.
examples: My friend and I went shopping.
Either you or your brother must come.

grammar.title: Four pairs and their meanings
grammar.explanation_ar: either...or = اختيار. not only...but also = مفاجأة + مفاجأة أكبر. neither...nor = نفي الاثنين. both...and = شمول الاثنين.
grammar.explanation_en: either...or = choice. not only...but also = surprise + bigger surprise. neither...nor = negation of both. both...and = inclusion of both.
examples: Either you watch the program or we turn off the TV. (choice)
Not only was it high quality, but it was also cheap. (surprise)
Neither the woman nor the man was happy. (negation)
Both the man and his dog were tired. (inclusion)

grammar.title: Word order
grammar.explanation_ar: ضع كل جزء من الزوج قبل نفس نوع الكلمة: either + فعل ... or + فعل؛ both + صفة ... and + صفة. إذا بدأت الجملة بـ Not only نقدّم الفعل المساعد: Not only was it... / Not only did it...
grammar.explanation_en: Put each part of the pair before the same kind of word: either + verb ... or + verb; both + adjective ... and + adjective. If a sentence starts with Not only, put the auxiliary first: Not only was it... / Not only did it...
examples: You can either call or write to us.
He was both tired and hungry.
Not only did he come late, but he also forgot his book.

questions.question: "___ my brother nor my sister likes fish."
"Both my father ___ my uncle are teachers."
"Not only was it cheap, ___ it was also good."
questions.explanation_ar: التركيب الصحيح: not only ... but also.

questions.question: "The dog neither ate nor slept." What happened?
choices: It didn't eat and didn't sleep.
questions.explanation_en: Neither...nor = not this and not that.

questions.question: Which word means a pleasant smell?
"Not only ___ late, but he also forgot his book."
questions.explanation_ar: بعد Not only في أول الجملة نقدّم الفعل المساعد: did he come.
questions.explanation_en: After Not only at the start, put the auxiliary first: did he come.
